content: Customer Vivaan Gupta called agent Vikram Singh to check the status of his life insurance policy (LC-2026-0456). After verifying that yesterday's $1,200 payment had cleared, the agent successfully activated the policy. The agent also confirmed the annual premium amount, provided an autopay setup link, and promised to email both a confirmation and a PDF copy of the policy.

action_items: Customer to use the autopay link to set up automatic payments
Agent to send confirmation email and PDF copy of the policy
